I, Coverage A, ¶ 1 (emphasis added)] (a) [3:293] “Occurrence”: “Occurrence” is defined as “an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions.” [CG 00 01 12 07, Sec. V, ¶ 13 (emphasis added)] 1) [3:293.1] “Accident”: Unless otherwise defined in the policy, the term “accident” is subject to the common law definition, i.e., “an unexpected, unforeseen, or undesigned happening or consequence from either a known or unknown cause.” This becomes part of the policy and it is not subject to challenge as ambiguous.
